recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. UP-597 already supplies the authoritative terminology content, and these two current-build core source fields were the only stale AdverseEvent category example lists found.
issue_request: FHIR-38908 was an Applied/Persuasive Patient Care issue for FHIR-core AdverseEvent. The final resolution was to add code clinical-research to the adverse-event category value set with definition "The adverse event pertains to clinical research."
initial_application: No FHIR-core commit tagged FHIR-38908 or UP-597 was found in AdverseEvent source history. The terminology change was applied externally through UTG as UP-597, and THO 6.5.0 contains the clinical-research code; however, core source still had two stale category example lists.
additional_context: AdverseEvent is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/adverseevent/valueset-adverse-event-category.xml includes all codes from the external THO CodeSystem http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/adverse-event-category. The code definition itself therefore belongs in THO, while core element/search-parameter summary text must stay consistent with it.
